Minigames: first look

Kid app style, your mascots, animations running live. Game art here is placeholder emoji; real games get their own drawn art. Everything is original.

1. Chore done → game earned

  • Mascot pops in with the news. Play now or save it (up to 5 saved, never expire).
  • Default: every finished chore earns one (parent can change).

2. The mascot wheel

  • Entry animation: mascot bounces in, wheel spins and slows.
  • Weighted to the kid's age group. Lands on a quick-fire run or one thinking game.

3. Quick-fire run (~1 min)

  • One command word, ~3 s each, back to back, getting faster.
  • 3 hearts. Good players fit more games into the minute; the minute never ends early for being good.

4. Hungry Cat (thinking/skill game, own clock)

  • Your daughter's favourite, our version: slide the cat, catch food, dodge socks.
  • Power-ups from the wheel sit in slots: Magnet curves food to the mouth, Multiply gives two cats.

5. Results and exit

  • Stars pop in one by one. Tickets turn into points (capped at a tenth of chore points per day).
  • Stars fill the next upgrade. Wheel sometimes gives a power-up. Badges pop last. Mascot waves off.

6. Games shelf and bedtime

  • Each game shows its stars. Family board compares within age group, personal bests first.
  • At bedtime and quiet hours games sleep until morning; saved games wait.

7. Parent: one simple card

  • On by default. One card: frequency, points cap, Trivia switch, leaderboard switch, per-kid on/off.
  • Parents trying to cut screen time switch it off here or per kid.
